description:
Deliver addressed peer messages only to live children in the same group. Best effort, nonblocking. Include the **parent** `send_minion_message` tool (not installed on children).

## Background

No durable mailbox, no exactly-once, no wait-for-reply, no parked sessions. Send returns immediately. Live recipient: steer/followUp at a child-safe boundary (may postpone idle). Terminal: recipient-terminal. Do not reroute through the parent. Peer messages do not start a parent turn.

Child send tools are bound closures from the inject issue. This issue owns delivery + the parent-facing send tool.

## Files

- `packages/pi-minions/src/messaging/`
- parent tool registration in `src/index.ts` / `src/tools/`
- tests

## Success criteria

- Same-group live delivery works (child→child and parent→child).
- Cross-group, missing, and terminal fail with a closed reason (recipient-terminal, invalid-recipient, group-not-open, mailbox-full).
- Child cannot forge sender identity.
- Parent inspects via list_minions/show_minion, not a parent turn per peer message.

## Test plan

- Unit: ACL, identity from closure, size/depth/rate limits.
- Integration: live vs disposed; parent send vs child send.
- Logging: messageId, from, to, status, bytes, whether a parent turn was triggered (must be false for peer-only).

## Considerations

Peer chat can delay settlement. Halt is the escape. No timeout product in V1. Mail vs settle single-winner is the sibling race issue.
